candidates.term: The General at the Month Gate
candidates.defline: The General stands at your Month Gate, in plain view: at work people see someone who can handle pressure.
candidates.reading: Authority shows on you before you say a word, and you are handed the hard jobs early. Because you meet pressure head on, you rise fastest in work with real stakes, and the crises that break others build your name. The friends you keep are mostly people who went through a hard stretch beside you, and colleagues respect you before they warm to you.
candidates.teaser: The working world reads command on you before you speak. Careers with stakes suit you, and your rank rises fastest where others crack.

domain_readings.Career: The working world reads command on you before you speak: careers with stakes suit your prime, operations, crises, leadership under weather. Your rank rises fastest exactly where others crack. Choose battles worth your metal and delegate the skirmishes. Midlife hands you real authority either way.
domain_readings.Social: Colleagues respect you first and warm to you second, in that order, always: your professional circle is built of proven people. The intensity that deters the casual attracts the serious. Keep one irreverent friend on staff. Command needs a court jester it trusts.

candidates.life_chapter: Your rising chapter is a campaign: the prime decades hand you pressure and watch you convert it, promotion by crisis, rank by weather survived. Expect your reputation to be forged in the storms others avoided. The era pays commanders, and it is paying you.
candidates.relations: The tested colleagues are this seat’s people: comrades from hard projects, loyal precisely because the loyalty was earned under fire. Parents may worry about the load these years. Show them the rank occasionally. It reads better than the schedule.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the command waits in reserve: capability visible, stakes unclaimed. Take point on one hard thing this quarter. The era notices.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, everything becomes an operation: meetings run, people managed, evenings scheduled. Stand down one day a week, fully.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, the commander cannot be off duty: relaxation experienced as dereliction.
candidates.health_line: Adrenaline is your working fuel and its own tax: decompress as professionally as you perform. The body honors the discipline it is shown.

Career.headline: Your career rises fastest where the stakes are highest.
Career.recognition: You are given the urgent problem, the team in trouble or the deadline that cannot slip. Because you stay steady when others panic, your managers trust you with more than your title says, and the load keeps growing. You earn rank through pressure, and you rarely get a quiet week.
Career.lived: Your reputation at work has grown out of hard moments since your late teens, the emergency handled or the project rescued. You were promoted at least once for the steadiness you showed in a bad week.

Social.headline: Your friends are people who have earned it.
Social.recognition: You keep a circle of people who have proved themselves, colleagues who stood with you when the work was hard. Because respect comes first for you, you leave a party once you have talked to the people you came for, and light talk feels like a waste of time. Your friendships are few and serious, and the people in them stay loyal for years.
Social.lived: Your closest friends since your late teens have been the people you worked hardest beside, in a tough job or a demanding team. Some acquaintances found you too intense and drifted off, and you kept the ones who stayed.
